title: Personal Todo List Workspace (Factory v2 Benchmark)

criteria.text: Clean minimal workspace on / with title 'Tasks', sidebar views (All Tasks, Today, Overdue) and default lists (Inbox, Work, Personal), live open counts, light/dark neutral tokens, and compact quick-add bar above the task list.
Quick-add creates a task with trimmed title (1-200 chars), optional expandable notes/due date/priority/list/tags, inline validation errors, and resets form on submit.
Toggling a task checkbox marks it complete/incomplete with strikethrough styling and immediately updates open counters across header, views, and lists.
Inline editing allows modifying title, notes, due date, priority, list, and tags with Save validation and Cancel/Escape discarding changes.
Deleting a task removes it immediately and shows an 8-second Undo toast/banner that restores the exact task on click.
Tasks, custom lists, tags, and sort order persist in localStorage; corrupted data resets safely with a dismissible warning banner.
Today and Overdue views classify tasks by local YYYY-MM-DD date; completed tasks never show Overdue badge.
Sort by Newest, Due date, or Priority applies across views and persists across reloads.
Users can create, rename, and delete custom lists (confirmation dialog moves tasks to Inbox); built-in lists cannot be renamed or deleted.
Users can attach up to 10 tags per task and filter any view/list by clicking a tag in the sidebar or on a task row.
Toolbar filters by All/Active/Completed and searches title/notes/tags in real time with Clear filters recovery state.
Full keyboard navigability, zero console errors, zero horizontal overflow at 1440px and 390px in light and dark modes.
